section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1999
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1999 N.C.R.B.,(M.H.A.) 2.11.2 As in the past, the four metropolitan cities Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi and Mumbai reported higher number of Suicides. These four cities have reported more than (51%) of the suicides reported from 23 mega cities. While Bangalore, Chennai and Delhi reported increases of 16.8, 6.7 percent and 13.7 percent respectively, Mumbai reported decreases over previous year. Among the other cities, Ludhiana (100%) and Jaipur (33.5%) reported significant rise in the suicides in 1999 over 1998. The cities such as Madurai (45%), Varanasi (29.6%) and Kanpur (25.1%) registered significant fall in the suicides that were reported during 1999 compared to 1998.
